content.short: Camelot is a native, ecosystem-centric DEX on Arbitrum featuring customizable liquidity and staked position NFTs.
content.description:
Camelot is the premier decentralized exchange and liquidity hub native to the Arbitrum network. It is designed as a highly flexible platform that supports both volatile and stable swap curves, allowing protocols to tailor their liquidity pools to specific needs. A unique feature of Camelot is its use of Staked Position NFTs (spNFTs), which wrap liquidity positions into composable assets that can be utilized across other DeFi protocols for enhanced yield.

The platform employs a dual-token system of GRAIL and xGRAIL, where the latter is an escrowed token that can be allocated to various plugins for dividends, yield boosts, or launchpad access. Through its Nitro Pools and permissionless incentive layers, Camelot acts as a launchpad and growth engine for new projects on Arbitrum, fostering a collaborative and sustainable DeFi environment.
